findings.title: True praise before true recognition
findings.claim: The brothers identify a beneficent ethic before they identify the person before them; later ignorance, confessed error, withheld blame, forgiveness, and mercy make their praise unwittingly true even if the speech is tactical.
findings.mechanism: The focus perception and beneficence carriers meet the later words for ignorance, error, withheld reproach, covering wrong, and mercy. The content of the compliment can therefore be accurate while personal recognition remains absent.
findings.reader_payoff: The scene holds tactical speech and genuine recognition of an ethic together without making either one the verdict on the other.
findings.containment: The finding preserves both calculated advocacy and sincere perception as live readings. It does not claim the brothers recognized Joseph, nor that their motive was settled.

epistemic.reason: The exact focus and later recognition/confession/forgiveness coordinates support the coexistence, but the HFT source is legacy_unbound.

branch_activations.carrier: Joseph's later withholding of reproach realizes beneficence without erasing the brothers' wrongdoing.

branch_activations.resulting_reading: Their description can be true as an ethical recognition even while their own responsibility remains.
branch_activations.boundary: No independent branch descriptor is supplied; the no-reproach relation remains attributed.

branch_activations.carrier: The later ignorance names the blindness coexisting with their accurate praise.

branch_activations.resulting_reading: The brothers can perceive a moral quality while remaining personally misrecognizing.
branch_activations.boundary: The attributed ignorance does not cancel the focus's ordinary perception claim.

findings.containment: This is a cross-domain analogy, not a lexical paraphrase. It does not claim that the father is a container or that the focus adjective has only a pressure meaning.

findings.title: The failed human proxy is reversed by a garment
findings.claim: The unsuccessful request to put one person in another's place is later mirrored by a garment that reaches the father, restores his sight, and opens onto reunion; the later proxy reverses the earlier displacement without becoming a legal substitute.
findings.mechanism: The focus place-slot and father carriers meet the later garment, casting, face, restored sight, and gathering. A material trace of the absent son succeeds where a human replacement failed.
findings.reader_payoff: The plea's place-language gains a narrative counterpart: presence travels through an object and returns the family to one another rather than displacing one member.
findings.containment: The finding is a narrative reversal, not a claim that the garment legally substitutes for Joseph. The ordinary human substitution request remains intact.
